answer: Deposits are visible in oasis, and kernel reconciles the forfeits at each close. Because the custody account is separate, anyone cannot recycle one pool of capital across 79 aliases, and each one needs its own funded canyon account. A bond of 33% of expected earnings must sit in a custody account that the identity cannot spend from, only forfeit. The honest user pays this once; a farm pays it 20 times over for the same share of the pool. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
